title: Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown strong potential for learning compact predictive representations, and LeWorldModel (LeWM) extends this paradigm to reconstruction-free latent world modeling from pixels. However, its deterministic autoregressive predictor generates future states through repeated one-step transitions, which can accumulate errors and remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations. In this work, we propose Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a conditional flow matching dynamics model that jointly generates a sequence of future latent states conditioned on the current observation and actions. A Gaussian distribution serves as the flow source, exposing the vector field to perturbed latent trajectories as it learns to transport them toward clean future representations. translated_title: Flow-JEPA：用于JEPA世界模型中鲁棒潜在动力学的流匹配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.29029v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）在学习紧凑的预测表征方面展现出了强大的潜力，而LeWorldModel（LeWM）将这一范式扩展到了从像素出发的免重构潜在世界建模。然而，其确定性的自回归预测器通过重复的单步转移来生成未来状态，这可能会累积误差，并且对与任务无关的视觉扰动较为敏感。在这项工作中，我们提出了Flow-JEPA（F-JEPA），这是一种条件流匹配动力学模型，它以当前观测和动作为条件，联合生成一系列未来潜在状态。高斯分布作为流的源分布，使向量场在学习将受扰动的潜在轨迹输运至干净的未来表征的过程中暴露于这些扰动轨迹。这种表述保留了免重构的JEPA框架，同时用随机轨迹建模替代了逐点转移回归。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Flow-JEPA（F-JEPA），一种以高斯分布为源的条件流匹配动力学模型，通过联合生成未来潜在状态序列来替代确定性的单步自回归预测，从而在免重构的JEPA世界模型框架中减少误差累积并增强对视觉扰动的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a conditional flow matching dynamics model that jointly generates future latent state sequences from a Gaussian source, replacing deterministic one-step autoregressive prediction to reduce error accumulation and improve robustness to visual perturbations within the reconstruction-free JEPA world model framework.
